name: Kozy Shack All Natural Tapioca Pudding
whyItWorks: Tapioca starch pearls (from cassava root) cook until gelatinous, translucent, and silky soft. Tapioca is hypoallergenic, gluten-free, and one of the easiest starches to digest in human biology.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat chilled. Take a lactase tablet if you have primary dairy lactose intolerance.
watchOuts: Contains real milk and eggs; take lactase enzyme if sensitive to lactose.
